ON.name: OSAP — Ontario Student Assistance Program
ON.eligibility: Canadian citizens, permanent residents, protected persons. Resident in Ontario for ≥12 consecutive months immediately before starting full-time post-secondary studies (with exceptions). Need-based grants + loans.
ON.deadline_note: Apply once you've accepted an offer — typically June for September start.
ON.international_eligibility: International students NOT eligible. Limited international scholarships available at each university directly.

BC.name: StudentAidBC
BC.eligibility: Canadian citizens, permanent residents, protected persons. BC residency required. Need-based grants + loans.
BC.deadline_note: Apply once you have a confirmed offer — typically May/June for September start.

AB.name: Alberta Student Aid
AB.eligibility: Alberta residents who are Canadian citizens, permanent residents, or protected persons.

QC.name: Aide financière aux études (AFE) — Quebec
QC.deadline_note: Apply once admitted; processing takes 4-6 weeks.
QC.international_eligibility: International students NOT eligible. Quebec has lower domestic tuition for residents — international tuition is significantly higher.
